description: Source file implementing high-level API functions for configuring user-defined field selectors in Realtek RTL8367C switch hardware. Contains functions to set and get field selector configurations via register access.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 format,rtk_uint32 offset)
methods.description: Configures a user-defined field selector by writing to hardware registers. Validates input parameters and combines format and offset into a register value, then writes via rtl8367c_setAsicReg.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pFormat,rtk_uint32 * pOffset)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a user-defined field selector by reading hardware register, parsing out format and offset, and returning them via pointers.
